reviewer: independent read-only G6 statistical input review

findings.title: G6 statistical pairing did not enforce same task lineage across G3 and G4
findings.evidence: Before this cycle, validate_statistical_inputs grouped rows only by (theory_family_id, cf_type, replicate). A read-only synthetic probe with G3 case_id=c3/paired_set_id=p3 and G4 case_id=c4/paired_set_id=p4 under the same family/CF/replicate was accepted, so responses from different tasks could enter one matched pair. The design requires paired_set_id to bind each counterfactual family and requires the same task to be compared across G3/G4; the corrected 552-row plan currently has 276 complete pairs and zero lineage mismatches.
findings.remediation: Require nonempty case_id and paired_set_id on every G6 plan row and reject any G3/G4 pair whose case_id or paired_set_id differs before statistical summaries are constructed. Retain the all-planned denominator and never rewrite historical artifacts.
